summary: Letters of administration under Indian Succession Act, 1925 s.278; will execution challenged after 30 years; Sections 63(c) Succession Act and 68 Evidence Act requirements for proof of will; inapplicability of s.90 Evidence Act presumption for wills; reliance on partition deed references; concurrent findings not interfered with; delay in filing challenged but rejected as non-derogatory to proof standards.
final_judgment: Appeal dismissed; Letters of administration upheld; concurrent findings of lower courts affirmed as will properly proved despite absence of attesting witnesses.
